headline: B.Riley Downgrades Lumentum Stock Rating Due to Marvell Deal Terms
summary: B.Riley downgraded Lumentum's stock rating following an evaluation of the terms of its deal with Marvell.
why: Corporate transactions and strategic agreements can alter a company's financial risk profile, prompting brokerage firms to revise their investment recommendations.

impacts.name: Lumentum Holdings
impacts.why: Transaction terms deemed unfavorable led to a rating downgrade by analysts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Unfavorable transaction terms led to an analyst downgrade, reducing market confidence in the equity.
